title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 159 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 159 - Explanation For the purpose of this Chapter, “Tax Assessed in the Last Income Year” means- (a) in the case of such taxpayer, before whom tax has been assessed; (b) in the case of such taxpayer, for whom tax has not been previously assessed.
